instruction_summary: Test whether the four load-bearing findings of Todd et al. (Function Vectors, ICLR 2024) still hold in 2023-2025 models across families (Llama/Qwen/OLMo) and the MHA->GQA shift, using an era ladder anchored on the paper's GPT-J-6B.

cost_accounting.notes: Debugging overhead was one fp32 Llama-2 antonym pass (~2.7 GPU-h) used to find a case-sensitivity bug + measure cost; discarded and re-run in bf16. Total wall-clock ~6.6 GPU-h, under the 8 GPU-h cap.

cost_cap_applied.reason_for_subset: fp32 was infeasible (CIE ~30min + full dual layer-sweep ~100min per task); the 3-task subset is the cost cap's explicit fallback. Applied to ALL new models uniformly.
cost_cap_applied.SL_measured: at peak layer only (not full sweep)

steps.description: Copy replication codebase to followup workspace (read-only reuse of dataset_files, .venv)

Add qwen branch + shape guard; fix case-insensitive arch dispatch + generic o_proj projection (original bug: local 'Llama-...' path failed lowercase 'llama' checks -> UnboundLocalError; qwen had no branch)
steps.command: edit utils/model_utils.py, utils/extract_utils.py, utils/intervention_utils.py; run_fu.py (shape_guard), run_fu2.py (fast driver)

steps.description: CIE + ZS layer sweep + SL@peak, bf16, 3-task subset, 4 core models
Head localization (C5) + induction prefix-match (C13) per model
C16 #heads plateau for flagship antonym per model (FV from this session's top-k AIE heads)
Isolated overlay venv (transformers 4.53) for Qwen3 (qwen3 arch unsupported by pinned 4.49); reuses base torch/baukit, pinned numpy 1.25
steps.command: uv venv qwen3-venv + base.pth + uv pip install transformers==4.53.2 numpy==1.25.0

key_results.notable: FV survives (high peak-layer accuracy) across all families EXCEPT: (a) Qwen3 country-capital FV fails entirely (peak 5.1% = baseline); (b) the Qwen GQA family's optimal edit layer drifted much later (0.64/0.55 depth) so the paper's canonical depth/3 layer collapses to ~6% for Qwen while Llama-2/OLMo-2 still peak early-mid.

comparison_to_original.quantity: mean top-1 zero-shot FV accuracy (6-task, canonical @L9)
comparison_to_original.followup: new models measured at peak on 3-task subset (see table)
comparison_to_original.note: GPT-J anchor read from disk; new numbers this session.
peak-to-peak, architecture-fair. FV strengthens for Llama-2/OLMo-2; Qwen3 hurt by country-capital failure.

comparison_to_original.quantity: per-task ZS FV @ L9 canonical (GPT-J anchor)

comparison_to_original.note: C2 layer-dependence: peak drifts later for the GQA Qwen family.

comparison_to_original.quantity: top-AIE head mid-layer concentration + induction prefix-match
comparison_to_original.original: GPT-J 9/10 in early-mid; flagged induction heads 8-1 .545, 12-10 .569, 24-6 .333
comparison_to_original.followup: concentration 0.61-1.00; induction top-K enriched vs all for Llama-2/Qwen2.5/Qwen3, NOT for OLMo-2
comparison_to_original.note: C5 mid-layer localization persists; C13 induction overlap is model-dependent.

deviations: bf16 for all new models instead of fp32 (instruction 3.5): fp32 just upcasts natively-bf16 weights (no accuracy gain) and made the study infeasible under the 8 GPU-h / 90-min-per-model cap. Rank-based FV accuracies are unaffected.

3-task subset {antonym, country-capital, present-past} for ALL new models (cost cap's explicit fallback), not the full 6 tasks. GPT-J anchor recomputed on the same subset for fair comparison (65.9% peak / 49.6% canonical).
SL (shuffled-label) FV measured at the peak layer only, not a full 32-layer sweep (the 10-shot-prompt sweep is the cost sink). ZS FV still fully swept for peak detection.

C16 #heads plateau run for the flagship antonym task per model (not all 3), and built from THIS session's top-k AIE heads (not the paper's hardcoded universal sets, which do not exist for the new models); filter set capped to 150 for the ablation.

Qwen3-8B-Base required transformers 4.53 (pinned venv is 4.49, which does not recognize the qwen3 arch). Built an isolated overlay venv reusing base torch/baukit; the pinned run venv was NOT modified.
Rung 6 Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct SKIPPED: gated and not present in local shared_models. 2024 covered by Qwen2.5; 2025 by Qwen3 + OLMo-2.
GPT-J and GPT-NeoX rungs reused from disk (fp16 on-disk numbers), not recomputed; new models are bf16 (precision note).
Code fix (not a scope change): made architecture dispatch case-insensitive and the head-projection generic; original code raised UnboundLocalError for the local capital-'Llama' path and for Qwen.
